requests.label: general
requests.question: Explain recursion in one short paragraph.

result.answer:
Recursion is a programming technique where a function calls itself directly or indirectly to solve a problem by breaking it down into smaller, similar sub-problems. For this to work without causing an infinite loop, every recursive function must have a "base case"—a specific condition where the function stops calling itself and begins returning values. Common examples include calculating factorials, generating Fibonacci sequences, or traversing tree structures in data.

I'm built specifically for Nile University, Egypt. This general answer isn't verified against university sources.

result.answer:
The Undergraduate Research Forum (UGRF) is a flagship event at Nile University that has been held successfully for 11 years. It is a semi-annual forum held at the end of each semester to encourage undergraduate students to turn their course projects into practical outcomes [1] [2].

The forum serves as a platform for students from various schools to submit scientific research for evaluation and publishing, as well as research projects for students in different academic years and graduation projects for final-year students [1]. Students present their work through 2-page summaries, videos, prototypes, and applications, which are then judged by a panel of university professors and senior researchers [2] [3].

Official pages for details and updates: [Home page](https://ugrf.nu.edu.eg/) · [22nd UGRF Submission Instructions](https://ugrf.nu.edu.eg/22nd-UGRF).

sources.text:
##
## The Journey of
## UGRF
Nile University organizes the semi-annual research forum for the undergraduate students periodically, as it is held once at the end of each semester. The research forum for students is one of the most important features of Nile University as a scientific research university and reflects the university’s plan for learning through innovation and applying research.
##
All university students from various schools participate in the forum. The forum includes the provision of scientific research from the students for evaluation and publishing, in addition to research projects for students of different academic years and graduation projects for final year students.
